summary: Slavic Fairy Tale is an aesthetic that is based on the fairy tales, mythology and overall folklore of eastern Slavic origin.
description: Slavic Fairy Tale is an aesthetic that is based on the fairy tales, mythology and overall folklore of eastern Slavic origin. Visually, it draws inspiration from such artists like Ivan Bilibin , Viktor Vasnetsov , Mikhail Vruvel , as well as Soviet animation and cinematography. It encompasses the the region's visual culture (architecture, clothing), themes and creatures from Slavic mythology and fairy tales (such as Baba Yaga, etc.), and common dark fantasy elements.
